_doc: The AI workforce: one entry per AGENT (a role/employee), not per model. `harness` names the model/tool that powers the agent for its default work; `runtimeAgentId` is the OpenClaw runtime agent that executes it. Models (Claude, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw) are tools, never employees. Live status is derived from the runtime by factory/lib/hq/activity.mjs, not stored here.

agents.name: Chief of Staff Agent
agents.responsibility: Turns founder goals into bounded work, classifies risk, routes tasks to the right agent, summarizes progress, and escalates only real founder decisions.

agents.name: Product Agent
agents.responsibility: Normalizes the objective into an observable outcome and testable acceptance criteria before design starts.

agents.name: Architect Agent
agents.responsibility: Proposes the smallest safe design, names data/security/privacy implications, defines interfaces and rollback, and challenges non-trivial architecture.

agents.name: Backend Builder Agent
agents.responsibility: Implements the smallest coherent change on an isolated branch, adds tests, runs checks, and opens a reviewable PR.

agents.name: Frontend Builder Agent
agents.responsibility: Implements UI/product changes with visual iteration and responsive checks; also the founder's interactive development surface.
agents.notes: UI/product implementation runs on the dedicated `frontend-builder` OpenClaw agent in a real isolated worktree (acpx ACP backend), using the OpenClaw gateway model (currently openai/gpt-5.6-sol). factory.config.json's `builder:cursor` routing token maps here — `cursor` is the historical name for the UI-builder slot, not a live Cursor session. There is no Cursor dependency.

agents.name: Reviewer Agent
agents.responsibility: Reviews the change it did not author for correctness, regressions, security, and acceptance-criteria gaps. Always a different model from the builder.

agents.name: QA Agent
agents.responsibility: Attempts to falsify the acceptance criteria, exercises failure and edge cases, and records evidence. Different harness from the builder.
agents.notes: The OpenClaw `qa` runtime agent runs on Claude via the acpx ACP backend (`runtime.acp.agent: "claude"` in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json), same pattern as architect/reviewer/security. Was codex-backed until 2026-09-05. `harness` stays "multiple" because the pipeline still selects QA to differ from the builder (task-workflow.mjs defaultAssignments); factory.config.json now maps both `qa:claude` and `qa:codex` to this one agent.

agents.name: Security Agent
agents.responsibility: Independent check for secret exposure, unsafe permissions, injection, data loss, and privacy regressions before release readiness.

agents.name: Release Manager Agent
agents.responsibility: Verifies every gate passed with evidence and independence, confirms no unresolved founder decision, and surfaces blockers. Never merges.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Turns an open question into a short brief with sources, findings, risks, and a recommended next action.
agents.notes: Real OpenClaw agent `research` created 2026-09-05, Claude-backed via the acpx ACP backend. Founder-invoked (not a pipeline stage); callable with `openclaw agent --agent research`.

agents.name: Learning / R&D Agent
agents.responsibility: Analyzes failed tasks and reviews, finds repeated mistakes, researches improvements, updates company knowledge, and proposes prompt/routing/gate changes for the founder to approve.
agents.notes: Real OpenClaw agent `learning` created 2026-09-05, Claude-backed via the acpx ACP backend. The scheduled analysis pipeline (scripts/factory-learn.mjs, factory/lib/learning/*) is deterministic and needs no model call; the model-backed agent is used for the research/synthesis dispatch (factory-learn.mjs research, which resolves `openclawIntegration.agentIds.learning`). `harness` reads "claude" to reflect the runtime agent; SFD-2026-006 (read-only, proposal-driven) is unchanged.
